scripts.bootstrap:maven: mvn -f pom.xml install -N -B && mvn -f backend/libs/fixna-platform-common/pom.xml clean install -DskipTests -B
scripts.build:all: npm run build:localboost && npm run build:consulting
scripts.test:consulting-api: npm run bootstrap:maven && mvn -f backend/consulting-api/pom.xml test
scripts.test:localboost-api: npm run bootstrap:maven && mvn -f backend/localboost-api/pom.xml test
scripts.test:all-apis: npm run test:localboost-api && npm run test:consulting-api
scripts.package:consulting-api: npm run bootstrap:maven && mvn -f backend/consulting-api/pom.xml -DskipTests package
scripts.package:localboost-api: npm run bootstrap:maven && mvn -f backend/localboost-api/pom.xml -DskipTests package
scripts.package:all-apis: npm run package:localboost-api && npm run package:consulting-api
